answer: Every claim of work is mirrored: a random peer re-runs the job and must reproduce the result, or both identities are flagged. A farm cannot forge a thousand histories this way, because each fake's work must be genuinely reproducible - one copied output fails its mirror check and burns the whole batch sharing that vertex of the graph. An honest agent's real work reproduces for free, while the farmer pays one full honest job per fake, and a single mismatch exposes the cluster.
